ModMetaData.name: Wake-Up: Loading Optimizations
ModMetaData.author: kt-nyx
ModMetaData.description:
Wake-Up 1.7 development preview. Retired search features remain disabled. A separate experimental translation predicate option is off by default; its loading-time benefit remains unqualified. Existing enabled preview preferences do not select the new experiment. No deferred-loading work is added.
Exact build checks require the reviewed 1.7.4984 rev1242 Linux references and recorded Harmony 3.0.0-rc.3 build. Current Windows bytes and execution remain unverified. Does not require or support Prepatcher on 1.7. Existing preview preferences are preserved.
No loading-time improvement is claimed. Final Windows verification, played installation and binary/tag/Workshop release remain local and owner-controlled. Not authorized for publication.
